name: Photo Essay
context: A short visual essay built from plausible candid moments. Replace this with the topic, place, audience, and emotional arc.
style: Photorealistic found-photo sequence, natural light or direct flash, imperfect framing, visible texture, ordinary details, no polished advertising look.
safety: Use fictional people unless the user provides references and consent. Avoid private information, readable addresses, IDs, brand logos, watermarks, and misleading real-person claims.
textPolicy: Avoid readable text unless a shot explicitly asks for short generic text. Keep signs, labels, and screens partial, blurred, or handmade.
